clips.title: The story
paras: At Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran Earthbinder sends orders to relieve a guard at the Great Lift. The letter promises Grish Longrunner leave to visit his family.

Maggran Earthbinder sends orders from Sun Rock Retreat to the Great Lift. Grish Longrunner, a Horde sentry at the post, is to be relieved by a replacement warrior. The Great Lift's wooden winches stand far to the south, where Grish has kept watch. With the new warrior taking his place, he can leave his post and return home to visit his family.
